violation_type.title: Maximum Height - 5 Yrs and Older (26 TAC §746.4607(b)(3))
violation_type.typical_finding: At the time of the inspection a play structure intended for children ages 5-12 years of age had a play surface over 7 ft in height. The surface area measured at 7 ft 4 inches exceeding the maximum height allowed by 4 inches.

finding_variants.text: At the time of the inspection a play structure intended for children ages 5-12 years of age had a play surface over 7 ft in height. The surface area measured at 7 ft 4 inches exceeding the maximum height allowed by 4 inches.

At the time of the inspection a play structure intended for children ages 5-12 years of age had a play surface over 7 ft in height. The surface area measured at 7 ft 8 inches exceeding the maximum height allowed by 8 inches.
The platform height of the large wooden play structure is 7 feet 2 inches.
The large playground climber measures 9 ft in height at the highest platform.    NOTE:  A waiver request was provided during the inspection.
